name: Control the Mac
description: «Abre Safari», «ejecuta el atajo Buenas noches», «abre la carpeta Descargas», «ve a la ventana de Mail», «teclea hola»: the Mac the server runs on, by voice and without the LLM (an app's name understood as it sounds: «crom»); and as tools for the LLM. Typing asks for your «yes»; the windows and typing need the Accessibility permission.
